title: Quantum Teleportation Circuit Simulator
h1: Simulate Quantum Teleportation in Your Browser
metaDescription: Build and run a quantum teleportation circuit live. Visualize Bell pairs, measure qubits, and see state transfer in real-time with QuantCAI's interactive simulator.

title: Grover's Search Algorithm Simulator
h1: Run Grover's Algorithm Step by Step
metaDescription: Explore Grover's quantum search algorithm interactively. Build the oracle, apply amplitude amplification, and measure quadratic speedup on QuantCAI.

title: Bell State Generator Simulator
h1: Create and Measure Bell States
metaDescription: Generate all four Bell states (Φ+, Φ-, Ψ+, Ψ-) with interactive quantum circuits. Understand entanglement fundamentals on QuantCAI.

title: Quantum Fourier Transform (QFT) Simulator
h1: Visualize the Quantum Fourier Transform
metaDescription: Build and simulate the Quantum Fourier Transform circuit. See phase rotations and understand the foundation of Shor's algorithm on QuantCAI.

title: Deutsch-Jozsa Algorithm Simulator
h1: Solve the Deutsch-Jozsa Problem in One Query
metaDescription: Implement the Deutsch-Jozsa algorithm and prove exponential quantum advantage. Interactive circuit builder with step-by-step gate visualization.

title: Quantum Error Correction Simulator
h1: Simulate the 3-Qubit Bit Flip Code
metaDescription: Learn quantum error correction by building the 3-qubit repetition code. Introduce errors, detect them, and correct them in real-time.

title: GHZ State Generator Simulator
h1: Create Multi-Qubit GHZ Entanglement
metaDescription: Build Greenberger–Horne–Zeilinger (GHZ) states with up to 8 qubits. Explore multi-party entanglement and quantum correlations on QuantCAI.

title: Quantum Phase Estimation Simulator
h1: Estimate Eigenphases with QPE
metaDescription: Implement Quantum Phase Estimation (QPE) interactively. Understand controlled rotations, inverse QFT, and eigenvalue extraction.

title: SWAP Test Circuit Simulator
h1: Compare Quantum States with the SWAP Test
metaDescription: Build the SWAP test to measure the overlap between two quantum states. A fundamental subroutine for quantum machine learning algorithms.

title: BB84 Quantum Key Distribution Simulator
h1: Simulate the BB84 QKD Protocol
metaDescription: Experience quantum cryptography hands-on. Simulate the BB84 protocol to exchange secret keys using quantum mechanics on QuantCAI.

title: Shor's Algorithm Circuit Simulator
h1: Understand How Shor's Algorithm Breaks RSA
metaDescription: Step through Shor's algorithm: modular exponentiation, QFT, and period finding. See why RSA-2048 is vulnerable to quantum computers.

title: ML-KEM (Kyber) Post-Quantum Encryption Explainer
h1: How ML-KEM Protects Against Quantum Attacks
metaDescription: Interactive visual guide to ML-KEM (CRYSTALS-Kyber), the NIST-standardized post-quantum key encapsulation mechanism. Understand lattice-based security.

title: ML-DSA (Dilithium) Digital Signature Explainer
h1: How ML-DSA Creates Quantum-Resistant Signatures
metaDescription: Visual explainer for ML-DSA (CRYSTALS-Dilithium), the NIST-approved post-quantum digital signature algorithm. Understand module lattices.

title: VQE Algorithm Simulator
h1: Simulate the Variational Quantum Eigensolver
metaDescription: Build a VQE ansatz circuit and find molecular ground state energies. Explore hybrid quantum-classical optimization on QuantCAI.

title: QAOA Circuit Simulator
h1: Solve Combinatorial Problems with QAOA
metaDescription: Implement the Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm (QAOA) interactively. Solve MaxCut and other combinatorial optimization problems.

title: True Quantum Random Number Generator
h1: Generate True Random Numbers with Quantum Mechanics
metaDescription: Create genuinely random numbers using quantum superposition. Understand why quantum randomness is fundamentally different from classical PRNGs.

title: Bernstein-Vazirani Algorithm Simulator
h1: Find the Secret String in One Query
metaDescription: Implement the Bernstein-Vazirani algorithm and find a hidden bit string with a single quantum query. Interactive circuit visualization on QuantCAI.

title: Quantum Walk Simulator
h1: Simulate a Discrete Quantum Walk
metaDescription: Build a quantum walk circuit and observe the quadratic spreading advantage over classical random walks. Foundational for quantum search algorithms.

title: Harvest Now, Decrypt Later Attack Simulator
h1: Why Your Encrypted Data Is Already at Risk
metaDescription: Understand the 'Harvest Now, Decrypt Later' threat. See how adversaries store encrypted traffic today to break it with future quantum computers.

title: Post-Quantum TLS Handshake Visualizer
h1: See How a PQC-Upgraded TLS 1.3 Handshake Works
metaDescription: Interactive visualization of a TLS 1.3 handshake upgraded with ML-KEM for post-quantum security. Compare classical vs. quantum-safe key exchange.
